candidate_source: R13 full 120-formula corpus: development AND consumed test used retrospectively for discovery; no R13 data will be presented as independent R14 validation

observation.eligible_when: degree_cv>=0.285 and early g<0.95 and early p>=43
observation.caveat: Six samples selected by retrospective analysis of both R13 folds; strongly susceptible to selection bias. This is hypothesis generation only.

modes.r14_dual50: old R13 primary OR complementary, restartint=50 (PRIMARY)
modes.r14_guarded50: old R13 primary OR guarded complementary, restartint=50 (threshold sensitivity control)

primary_endpoint: PAR-2 percent improvement of R14_dual50 vs same-binary monitor over 60 prospectively generated random3-SAT formulas in reserved test fold, 3 paired repeats per formula, stratified formula-block bootstrap 95% CI
secondary_endpoint: Head-to-head R14_dual50 vs R13_rescue50 and forced50; number of new gate activations, >2x gains/regressions, transfer to 20 new community-structured 3-SAT reserved test instances, correctness, hashes, telemetry
provenance: Generate 120 iid random3 and 40 separate community-biased 3-CNF before test; historical SHA registry frozen before benchmark, not official competition.
disclaimer: A retrospective R13 signal is not confirmed unless a frozen R14 rule succeeds on new independent formulas and uncertainty supports it. A small favorable sample is NOT a world record or mathematical law.
